scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify --outfile dist/gyst src/index.tsx && bun scripts/build-skills.ts
scripts.build:release: crust build --entry src/index.tsx --name gyst --outdir dist/release --resolver gyst
scripts.package: cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && cp ../../README.md README.md && crust build --package --entry src/index.tsx --name gyst --stage-dir dist/npm
scripts.test: bun test && bun src/tui/smoke.tsx && bun src/tui/app-races.smoke.tsx
